Name: Partner-Authentication
Title: Sign in to the partner portal
Purpose: A per-application sign-in flow: identify, password, an optional second factor, log in. Attached to the SAML and proxy providers, so the instance's default flow is never touched

Name: Consented-Authorization
Title: Approve access
Purpose: An authorization flow with an explicit, expiring consent step, attached to the expenses OAuth2 provider in place of the implicit default

Name: Contractor-Enrolment
Title: Contractor enrolment
Purpose: An enrolment flow made of one deny stage, which the reusable invitation is tied to; anyone holding that link reaches a refusal
